> 第 9章 泰坦之威严（第1页）
从祭司的营帐出来，姜尤便离开了王庭的驻地，往自家族人的所在而去。
战争虽然胜利，但还不能立刻离开。
离开王庭驻地之时，那名王庭鹰人战士告诉他。
因为他似乎很自信，姜尤将来，必定还会回到王庭。
不止是他，似乎整个鹰人王廷的人都是这么自信！
然后又告诉他，三日之后，还有一场各族为雷霆泰坦亚特里准备的庆功大会需要参加！
届时，需要所有人盛赞伟大的雷霆泰坦！
找到族人们后，他们回到刚开始安置部落鹰人们的营地。
姜尤这才发现，整个营地的部落鹰人十不存一，每一个活下来的部落鹰人都满含泪水，如同行尸走肉一般。
这场战争，耗干了大荒各部部落鹰人们的血！
然而王廷高高在上，无人敢于反抗。
在阿桑的解释下，原本他们在姜尤引开双头飞龙之后，便被一队王廷鹰人战士临时征召，编入炮灰队列，放在最前，迎战巨龙一方的狮鹫群。
很快便有十几个族人战死，好在有青铜甲护身，且战争在泰坦巨人撕裂蓝龙王后结束，这才没有更大的伤害！
“王廷的鹰人战士永远都处在队伍的最后，指挥各部落鹰人迎战，所以每一次战争下来，王廷的伤亡最小！”
“这就是部落鹰人十不存一的原因！”
姜尤听完，对鹰人王廷的愤怒更甚！
他决定了，这一次回去，便不鸟王廷的命令了。
至于高蛮山部落所在地，等找到更好的驻地，便不待了。

泰坦与巨龙的终极大战爆发，鹰人王廷还存不存在，都是个问题。
姜尤带着族人们，安安静静地坐在营地中，静静等待泰坦巨人的到来。
一名高两百多米的泰坦巨人，一步一步地走到各族营地的中央！
他的身上缭绕着毁天灭地的雷霆，一颗巨大的龙头被他做成了头盔，戴在头上。
他垂眸看向脚下密密麻麻如同蝼蚁般的智慧生物，眼底流露出一丝漠然和无趣。
要不是泰坦之王告诉他们，这些蝼蚁般的智慧生灵身上，藏着成神的秘密，他才不会管这些蚂蚁的死活。
“我的奴仆们，为你们的主人欢呼吧！”
“伟大的泰坦，终将统治费兰德的一切！”
犹如轰塌天地的雷鸣在天地之间炸响，浩瀚的威严扫过整个瀚海森林！
所有生灵被这威压一压，顿时心神震颤，身躯垮下！
而像亚特里这样的泰坦强者，早就是半神级！
但吸收了泰坦与巨龙之血的他只一瞬间便回过神来，抬眸仰望，看着那犹如坐在云端，顶天立地，宛若世界之王的泰坦巨人，心生不屈和炙热！

Western Fantasy: From the Eagle Tribe to the Angel Empire Latest Chapter_Chapter 9 The Majesty of Titans Page 1_Western Fantasy: From the Eagle Tribe to the Angel Empire Feng Xiaoya_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 9 The Majesty of Titans (Page 1)
After coming out of the priest's tent, Jiang You left the royal court and went to where his family members were.
Although the war is won, we cannot leave immediately.
When leaving the Royal Court station, the Royal Court Eagle Warrior told him.
Because he seemed very confident that Jiang You would definitely return to the royal court in the future.
Not just him, it seems that the entire Yingren Wangting is so confident!
Then he told him that in three days, there will be a celebration meeting prepared by all races for the Thunder Titan Yatri that he needs to attend!
At that time, everyone needs to praise the great Thunder Titan!
After finding the tribesmen, they returned to the camp where the tribal eagles were first placed.
Only then did Jiang You realize that there were not even a single tribal hawk left in the entire camp, and every surviving tribal hawk was filled with tears, like a walking corpse.
This war has drained the blood of the eagle people from all tribes in the wilderness!
However, the royal court was so high that no one dared to resist.
Under Asang's explanation, after Jiang You lured the two-headed flying dragon away, they were temporarily recruited by a group of Wang Ting Yingren warriors and put into a cannon fodder queue, placed at the front to face the griffons on the dragon's side.
Soon, more than a dozen tribesmen died in the battle. Fortunately, they were protected by bronze armor, and the war ended after the Titans tore the Blue Dragon King apart, so there was no greater harm!
"Wang Ting's eagle warriors are always at the end of the team, commanding the eagle warriors of each tribe to fight, so in every war, Wang Ting's casualties are minimal!"
"This is the reason why there are not even one tribal hawk left in ten!"
After Jiang You heard this, he became even more angry at Yingren Wang Ting!
He decided that this time when he went back, he would not obey the royal court's orders.
As for the location of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe, we won’t wait until we find a better location.
When the final battle between the Titans and the Dragons breaks out, whether the Yingren King's court still exists or not is a question.
Jiang You and his clan members sat quietly in the camp, waiting for the arrival of the Titans.
A Titan, more than two hundred meters tall, walked step by step to the center of the camps of all races!
His body was surrounded by thunder that destroyed the world, and he made a huge dragon head into a helmet and wore it on his head.
He lowered his eyes to look at the densely packed ant-like intelligent creatures at his feet, with a hint of indifference and boredom in his eyes.
If the King of Titans hadn't told them that these ant-like intelligent beings contained the secret to becoming gods, he would not have cared about the lives of these ants.
"My slaves, hail your master!"
"The great Titan will eventually rule everything in Ferland!"
Just like the thunder that collapsed the heaven and earth, it exploded between the heaven and the earth, and the vast majesty swept across the entire vast forest!
All creatures were suppressed by this pressure, their hearts trembled and their bodies collapsed!
And a strong Titan like Yatri has long been a demigod!
But after absorbing the blood of Titans and dragons, he came back to his senses in just a moment. He raised his eyes and looked up at the Titans who seemed to be sitting on the clouds, standing tall on the sky and on the ground, like the king of the world. His heart felt unyielding and hot!
